name: Anneliese Dubois
bio:
Anneliese's meticulous nature found its perfect outlet in the high-stakes world of motorsport logistics. Growing up in a small village near the Alps, she was captivated by the precision and teamwork required for racing, even from afar. After earning a degree in Supply Chain Management, she started her career assisting a small rally team, quickly proving her ability to handle complex logistical challenges under pressure.

Joining Eurofarma RC was a significant step up, and Anneliese thrives on the fast-paced environment. She's known for her uncanny ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise, ensuring that the team's equipment and personnel are always in the right place at the right time. Anneliese's calm demeanor and unwavering attention to detail make her an invaluable asset, especially when deadlines are tight and tensions are high. She's particularly skilled in navigating international customs regulations, a talent that has saved the team considerable time and money on multiple occasions.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly kept in a low ponytail, with a few strands framing her face
physical.description: Anneliese has a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small Swiss Army knife, even indoors
Insists on using a paper planner despite the availability of digital tools
Has a habit of meticulously labeling everything, including her own belongings
